text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Rebuilt: the mean of UKV's two snapshots, added after the first run. Since August 2024: Open-Meteo's own UKV download. The upgrade: January 2026; its rows rest on 7 months, so their intervals are likely too narrow. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to August 2026. All rows are exploratory.'
